new_claims.scope: Two literal physical hubs with rank-two hub-to-leaf frame; arbitrary symmetric leaf block; all physical leaf leverages strictly below one.
new_claims.statement: With C=A[L,H], G=C^T C, Delta=det G, ell_i=c_i^T G^{-1}c_i, and V_i the actual singleton-augmentation physical three-volume after moving leaf i and puncturing it from the opposite bank, there exist symmetric M, diagonal Lambda and symmetric zero-diagonal E with D=C M C^T+Lambda+E and ||E||_F <= [(2/Delta) sum_i V_i/(1-ell_i)]^(1/2).

new_claims.scope: Same frame, V_i=0 for every leaf and no exact coloop.

key_identity: V_i=Delta(1-ell_i) delta_i^2, where delta_i^2=min_u sum_{j!=i}(D_ij-c_j^T u)^2.
coarse_corollary: If q=max ell_i<1 and V=sum V_i, then ||E||_op<=||E||_F<=sqrt(2V/[Delta(1-q)]).
structural_interpretation: ell_i=1 iff deleting the literal physical leaf i destroys rank two of the hub frame; the denominator singularity is exactly the physical-coloop branch.
correction_aware_limitation: Do not transfer density estimates from the exact slope-form matrix to the original matrix by treating E as a small random quadratic error. The Frobenius/operator estimate is for deterministic structural/spectral routing only.

partner_application.actual_target_valid_inequality: For A_s=[[0,M_s],[M_s^T,0]] with rows (s,0,0),(0,1/sqrt2,0)x2,(0,0,1/sqrt2)x2, spectrum is +/-s,+/-1,+/-1, selected Z=s^2 and non-anchor marginals are 1/2; hence ||p||_inf <=5*2^(4/5)*sqrt(e)s^(-1/5). At s=32 this is <7.177, with continuity and P(Q in I)<7.177|I|.
